notes: The museum is named UC Irvine Langson Orange County Museum of Art on the page. Confirm dates and any stipend with the museum first.
name: Orange County Young Curators (OCYC)
org: UC Irvine Langson Orange County Museum of Art
what_you_do: Work with museum staff to learn about museums, art and curating. The group builds an exhibition from start to finish that opens to the public.
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors from anywhere in Orange County. The 2025-26 group came from 9 school districts and was chosen from over 100 applicants.
pay_detail: Not stated on the pages read
duration: One school year; the 2025-26 exhibition opens in June 2026
deadline_text: Application dates for the next group are not on the museum pages read.
how_to_apply: Application steps are not listed on the pages read. Email langsonteens@uci.edu to ask.
